stem.text: The charge that a fully charged $12\,\text{V}$ car battery can supply is $100\,\text{kC}$. The starter motor of the car requires a current of $200\,\text{A}$ for an average period of $2.0\,\text{s}$. The battery does not recharge because of a fault.
What is the maximum number of times the starter motor of the car can be used?
